description: The reader asks outright for something to read next. `get_recommendation` is the only intent the application maps to `direct` presentation, and the skill names it as web-primary regardless of the cue's wording. The case checks both: the web route is taken, and the presentation is carried through unchanged rather than downgraded to asking first.

input.cue: Give me something to read next that deals with not recognising yourself.

tool_evidence.title: Personal Identity
tool_evidence.excerpt: The source surveys what makes a person at one time the same person at another time.

tool_evidence.title: Self-Knowledge
tool_evidence.excerpt: The source examines how a person comes to know their own mind, and why that knowledge is not automatic.

criteria: Offers the source as something to read, answering the request that was made
Says what the reader would get from it without claiming it settles anything about them
Preserves the direct presentation rather than asking whether to show it
forbidden_claims: Claims the source describes the reader's own situation
